_comment: THE case table for the location display formatter, which exists twice:
Both test suites read THIS file, so the two copies cannot drift silently.
It lives under backend/tests/ because the backend test run only ever sees
backend/ (pytest runs inside the dev container, where ./backend is mounted
as /app), while Vitest runs from the repo checkout and can reach up.
Shapes below are real: the 'nominatim_*' ones are verbatim display_name
addressdetails=1&countrycodes=ch (no accept-language, which is why the
'home_*' ones are what frontend/lib/geocoding.ts actually stores.

cases.name: home_natural_form
cases.why: The shape every row in the dev database has – the city is redundant.

cases.name: home_free_text_with_hint
cases.why: Operator free text kept intact; only the home city is stripped.

cases.name: home_house_number_first
cases.why: Raw Nominatim display_name for a home-city address.
cases.address: 8, Storchenweg, Oberwil, Bezirk Arlesheim, Basel-Landschaft, 4104, Switzerland

cases.name: home_city_only_multilingual_country
cases.why: Nothing more specific than the home city – hidden. Before the fix the multilingual country component became the street.

cases.name: home_city_bare
cases.why: The configured home city, echoed back as the location.

cases.name: b1_main_street_basel
cases.why: Blocker B1: index 1 is the STREET here, so the city lookup must not take it.

cases.name: b1_rue_du_rhone
cases.why: Blocker B1, second audited example.

cases.name: b1_bahnhofstrasse_liestal
cases.why: Blocker B1, third audited example, with the full Swiss tail.
cases.address: 12, Bahnhofstrasse, Liestal, Bezirk Liestal, Basel-Landschaft, 4410, Schweiz/Suisse/Svizzera/Svizra

cases.name: nominatim_house_number_first
cases.why: Verbatim display_name for 'Bahnhofstrasse 12 Liestal' – the Nachbarhilfe case.
cases.address: 12, Bahnhofstrasse, Pratteln, Bezirk Liestal, Basel-Landschaft, 4133, Schweiz/Suisse/Svizzera/Svizra

cases.name: nominatim_canton_after_bezirk
cases.why: A canton that is not in any list: what follows a 'Bezirk …' is the canton, the town sits before it.
cases.address: 12, Amthausstrasse, Dornach, Bezirk Dorneck, Solothurn, 4143, Schweiz/Suisse/Svizzera/Svizra

cases.name: nominatim_street_without_house_number
cases.why: Verbatim display_name for a street: index 0 is the street, index 1 the town.
cases.address: Storchenweg, Therwil, Bezirk Arlesheim, Basel-Landschaft, 4106, Schweiz/Suisse/Svizzera/Svizra

cases.name: nominatim_place_only
cases.why: A municipality, not an address – no city to append. Before the fix this ended in ', Schweiz/Suisse/Svizzera/Svizra'.

cases.name: nominatim_poi_prefixed
cases.why: Verbatim display_name for 'Bahnhof Basel SBB' – POI first, suburb and borough before the city.
cases.address: Basel SBB, Centralbahnstrasse, St. Alban, Grossbasel, Basel, Basel-Stadt, 4002, Schweiz/Suisse/Svizzera/Svizra

cases.name: natural_form_out_of_town
cases.why: What the geocoder stores for a neighbouring town – already correct today, must stay untouched.

cases.name: already_street_and_city
cases.why: 'Street 12, City' – nothing to strip.

cases.name: bare_title_no_comma
cases.why: Free text with no components at all.

cases.name: missing_city
cases.why: House number and street, nothing else.

cases.name: missing_city_with_tail
cases.why: Postcode and country present, city missing – no empty ', ' tail.

cases.name: map_pin_coordinates
cases.why: The reverse-geocode fallback in use-route-planning / map-picker.

cases.name: neighbour_town_containing_canton_abbrev
cases.why: Blauen BL is a real neighbouring municipality. A substring test matched the 'BL' of the setting inside 'Blauen' and dropped the town – exactly the part a Nachbarhilfe address must keep.

cases.name: street_containing_canton_abbrev
cases.why: Same substring trap one component earlier: the STREET carries the letters, and the whole address was read as home.

cases.name: nominatim_street_containing_canton_abbrev
cases.why: The same street in the raw display_name shape, where the tail also carries the canton in full.
cases.address: 12, Blauenstrasse, Aesch, Bezirk Arlesheim, Basel-Landschaft, 4147, Schweiz/Suisse/Svizzera/Svizra

cases.name: town_name_extends_home_city
cases.why: Oberwil im Simmental (BE) is not Oberwil (BL): a component that merely STARTS with the home city is a different municipality and keeps its name.

cases.name: home_city_case_and_spacing_insensitive
cases.why: The setting is free text an operator types – case and stray spacing must not decide whether the town is stripped.

cases.name: home_city_whitespace_only
cases.why: A cleared setting saved as spaces is unset, not a home city that matches nothing – the address is passed through, like with an empty setting.

cases.name: no_home_city_configured
cases.why: Fresh station: nothing to strip against, so the address is passed through.

cases.name: empty_address
cases.why: An incident without a location.
